summary.what_it_is: A command-line tool that makes a MacBook's Force Touch trackpad produce audible speech and sound by driving its haptic motor up to 4,000 times per second, using macOS's private MultitouchSupport framework.
summary.why_trending: New project (0 days old) demonstrating a novel technique to turn a trackpad's haptic motor into a speaker for voice synthesis, gaining rapid attention for its clever use of private APIs and single-file Swift implementation.
summary.who_its_for: MacBook users with Force Touch trackpads (2015 or later) who want to experiment with haptic audio, and developers interested in low-level macOS haptics.
